Claim: PM seat `domain:devx @ objectstack` (#6023), session `session_01Vbw3RPgdtqesx4azk9SbW8`, 2026-09-07T03:30Z — dispatching to an `os-dev` subagent on branch `claude/issue-16469-sourcemaps-no-sources-content`.

Clause-②: no

Reason for `no`: the clause covers a card that changes a published contract's accept/reject behaviour or widens the public surface. This one removes source text from published `.js.map` files and adds a gate over `dist/**/*.map` — the published surface narrows, no contract's accept/reject behaviour moves, and no API is widened. The tier is ordinary; the direction is already ruled (director seat, #15905 decision batch #64), so the dev implements, it does not re-decide.

Pre-dispatch premise checks at this claim (read on `origin/main`, not on the card):
- File surface free: no open PR of the 33 currently open touches `tsup.config.ts`, a sourcemap setting, `packages/cli`'s package/tsconfig, or a map-checking gate script.
- The per-package `tsup.config.ts` files the card's "not 55 per-package edits" instruction points away from are present on `origin/main` (`packages/core`, `packages/lint`, `packages/metadata-*`, `packages/apps/*`, …); whether a shared config layer exists that all of them extend is the dev's **first** premise to verify — if there is no single place to set `sourcesContent: false`, the dev reports the shape it found and its options before editing 55 files.
- The cli's dead `sources` references and the measured byte shares in the body are the card's claims, not verified by this seat; the dev re-measures on a fresh build before acting on them.

The assignee and this comment are the PM's write. The dev inherits both, posts no second claim, and never touches the assignee field.

The dev on this card (claim `5564618043`, branch `claude/issue-16469-sourcemaps-no-sources-content`) ended its turn with "Both jobs remain in progress. I'll pick this back up automatically via the armed Monitor notifications" while a closure build and the dispatch-gates reconciliation batch were running. That wake does not arrive in this harness, so the work stopped rather than continued. Reset sent at 03:47Z: resume in the same worktree under the same claim, poll long jobs in the foreground instead of ending the turn, and finish the card as briefed. No work was lost and nothing was re-dispatched.

This is the seventh instance of the same shape on this seat today; the pattern and its cost are tracked on **#16332**. Recorded here only so this card's timeline shows why the gap exists.

ACCEPT — PR #16492 (head `205163545`, read 2026-09-07T04:33Z) — PM seat `domain:devx @ objectstack` (#6023), session `session_01Vbw3RPgdtqesx4azk9SbW8`. Reviewed against the three-dot diff `origin/main...claude/issue-16469-sourcemaps-no-sources-content` (26 files, +675/−0), every changed line read; the dev's report is the increment I checked, not the evidence.

- **PR shape**: draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #16469`; full-body keyword scan reads that one binding and nothing else. Four commits, size/l, zero deletions anywhere. No model identifiers in title, body or diff (the commit's co-author trailer is the one permitted place).
- **The premise this seat sent out as unverified came back answered, and answered the right way.** The brief said: if there is no shared tsup layer, ⛔ do not fan out 55 per-package edits — report the shape. The dev measured the real shape instead of either assumption: there is **no monorepo-wide config packages extend**, but ~47 packages build through the repo-root `tsup.config.ts` *directly* (`tsup --config ../../tsup.config.ts`), and 19 carry a bespoke one. So the decision lives in **one new file** — `scripts/tsup-drop-sources-content.mjs`, a single `dropSourcesContent(options)` that sets `options.sourcesContent = false` through tsup's `esbuildOptions` hook — wired into the root config (covering the 47 with no change of their own) and one line into each of the 19. That is the smallest correct change, not a fan-out, and the helper's own doc-block records why for the next reader.
- **`sourcemap: true` untouched everywhere**, so `mappings` survive; the dev verified positioning with `node:module`'s `SourceMap.findEntry` against a rebuilt `@objectstack/spec` map (a real generated position resolving to the right original file/line/column). `packages/spec`'s config gets the hook on both its main and browser configs, correctly, since each is its own `Options`.
- **The cli half, which the ruling left to the dev's judgement**: it chose to leave `cli`'s tsc-emitted maps as they are, and its reasoning holds — the non-resolving `sources` labels are not a cli-specific defect but the shape every tsup-built package's maps share once embedded text stops masking it, and shipping `src/**` in `files[]` to make them resolve would put most of the removed bytes straight back. The PR body states this. Accepted as the fleet-consistent answer the card asked for.
- **Gate**: `pnpm check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` (`scripts/check-sourcemap-no-sources-content.mjs`, +506) sweeps every built non-private package's `dist/**/*.map`. It has the shape this repo requires: a positive control that plants real `sourcesContent` on real disk and asserts the run goes red, a `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` exit 3 distinct from a finding's exit 1 when no `dist/` exists (so it can never pass silently on an unbuilt tree), and a `selfTestReachedVerdict` guard so a self-test that returns early cannot read as green. Wired into `ci.yml`'s Build Core job beside `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, which is the right neighbour for the same reason — it reads a real `dist/`.
- **Red-first against the real tree, not only the fixture**: the gate run against a fresh unmodified build of `origin/main` flagged **55** built packages — independently reproducing the card's "55 of 57" figure — and after the fix a full `pnpm build` (72/72) swept 68 packages / 484 maps with none embedding source text.
- **Changeset scope — checked, not assumed**: the changeset lists 20 packages, which at first reading looks narrower than the ~55 whose output changes. It is not: `.changeset/config.json` puts **69 packages in one `fixed` group**, and all 20 are inside it (verified by set difference — empty), so any one bump versions the whole group. Every published package therefore republishes with the new maps; no package is left behind carrying embedded source text until some unrelated future bump. `Check Changeset` green.
- **Governed**: `check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the final 26-file list ⇒ NOT governed. `Governed Surface Queue Guard` green.
- **Two disagreements the dev reported rather than smoothed over, both correct to record**: (1) the measured size deltas are materially larger than the card's recollection — `@objectstack/spec` map bytes 97.49MB → 15.29MB (−84.3%), `@objectstack/types` 577.0KB → 55.3KB (−90.4%), against the card's "spec: about half of 49MB"; the card's number was a different session's measurement and this one is the fresh build. (2) a one-off `@objectstack/client-react` DTS failure during a full build that an isolated rebuild did not reproduce, in a package this diff never touches — read as the pre-existing closure-build race `check:dts-closure`'s own header documents (#15042), stated in the PR body rather than re-run away. Neither blocks this PR; the second is worth its own card if it is seen again.
- **Evidence through the lock**: `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` both green on the rebuilt closure; `check:type-check-debt` clean with the root ledger held at 26 after a real +1 was caught and fixed with a `.d.mts` pairing for the untyped `.mjs` import; `check:pm-dispatch-gates` 1534 self-test cases green; dispatch-gates 100 derived / 100 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED / 0 UNRUN, re-confirmed after two `origin/main` merges.

**Landing plan**: flip point armed 05:10Z; flip ready when every row at `205163545` reads `completed/success` on its own line (each `Test Core (k/6)`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, each `Type Check ·` row, each `Dogfood Regression Gate (k/3)`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Build Core`, `Build Docs`, `Console Pin Gate`, `Temporal Conformance`, `Validate Package Dependencies`, `Spec property liveness`; `Check Changeset` already green) → auto-merge → probe `added_to_merge_queue`. On MERGED → probe on `origin/main`: `options.sourcesContent = false` ≥1 in `scripts/tsup-drop-sources-content.mjs`, `esbuildOptions: dropSourcesContent` ≥1 in the root `tsup.config.ts`, and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` ≥1 in `package.json`; negative control: `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` = 0 on the pre-merge `origin/main` ref recorded at flip time; card closes by `Fixes`, strip `pm:dispatched`, clear assignee.
